about.text: Provoleta is an Argentine variant of provolone cheese described as "Argentine pulled-curd provolone cheese". It can be heated on a grill, or indoors in a cast-iron pan. The cheese is firm and can hold its shape when grilled.

how.label: spin the curd
how.text: Provoleta is an Argentine provolone-type spun-curd cheese sold in small thick discs; the spun curd is dense enough to hold its shape when grilled whole at an asado.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: spin
steps.note: The curd is spun (hilado), as for provolone.
Formed into discs about 10–15 cm across and 1–1.5 cm thick.
